catalog_scope.name: Database - Item Files
catalog_scope.rule: Current WikiEntryDataTable records with a non-empty refItemId that resolves in ItemTable, excluding the 77 weapon IDs curated separately.

classification_model.storage: Each item has a classifications array; classes are additive and non-exclusive.

definitions.label: Collectible
definitions.derivation: Official Collectible item type, or an Ornamental exposed by Item Files.

definitions.label: Consumable
definitions.derivation: Official Consumable item type, Usables showing type, or Usable Items database group.

definitions.label: Craftable
definitions.derivation: Explicit outcome of a current factory, manual-craft, gear-assembly, Dijiang manufacture, or cultivation formula.

definitions.label: Crafting ingredient
definitions.derivation: Explicit material, seed, currency, or ingredient consumed by a current formula.

definitions.label: Equipment
definitions.derivation: Official Gear item type or gear database/showing group.

definitions.label: Material
definitions.derivation: Official material/progression type or a material, resource, gatherable, progression, or AIC-product client grouping.

definitions.label: Progression material
definitions.derivation: Official Operator, Weapon, Essence, or Rare Progression Material type, or a progression/rare-material client grouping.

definitions.label: Gatherable
definitions.derivation: Official Gatherables database/showing group, including mineral and plant showing types.

definitions.label: Natural resource
definitions.derivation: Official Natural Resources database group.

definitions.label: Plant
definitions.derivation: Official Plants showing type.

definitions.label: Mineral
definitions.derivation: Official Minerals showing type.

definitions.label: AIC product
definitions.derivation: Official Products showing type or AIC Products database group.

definitions.label: Facility
definitions.derivation: Official Basic Facility item type, Production showing type, or any building database group.

definitions.label: Logistics
definitions.derivation: Official Logistics item type or Logistics Units database group.

definitions.label: Tactical item
definitions.derivation: Official Tactical item type.

definitions.label: Functional item
definitions.derivation: Official Miscellaneous/functional item type or Functional Items database group.

definitions.label: Personal device
definitions.derivation: Official Personal Device item type, showing type, or database group.

definitions.label: Gift
definitions.derivation: Official Gift item type or Operator Gifts database group.

definitions.label: Ornamental
definitions.derivation: Official Ornamental item type or Ornamental building database group.

definitions.label: Mission item
definitions.derivation: Official Mission Item item type.

definitions.label: Currency
definitions.derivation: Official Currency, Event Currency, or Stock Bill item type.

definitions.label: Permit
definitions.derivation: Official Engraving Permit item type.

definitions.label: Seed
definitions.derivation: Official Seed item type.

definitions.label: Essence material
definitions.derivation: Official Essence Material item type.

definitions.label: Valuable
definitions.derivation: Official Valuable item type.

notes: This initial snapshot intentionally follows the current in-game Database - Item Files boundary. It does not import hidden/internal ItemTable rows, profile cosmetics, every mission prop, or the 77 weapons already owned by the Weapon dataset.
The 731 records are distinct by stable client item ID. Names are not identity keys: several fluid and gas container records intentionally share the same English and Simplified Chinese display name.

classifications is a many-valued set. Client-backed identity classes such as material, facility, and equipment can coexist with behavior classes such as craftable, crafting-ingredient, consumable, and collectible.

craftable and crafting-ingredient are derived only from explicit current client formula outcomes and costs across factory, manual crafting, gear assembly, Dijiang manufacture, and cultivation tables. Acquisition text alone is not treated as a recipe.

English, Simplified Chinese, and Vietnamese names were selected independently by matching exact values at the same client localization key. Four casing or numeral-style variants are preserved without treating them as different item identities.

Hán-Việt names were generated from the verified Simplified Chinese localization using readings returned by the Thi Viện Hán-Nôm dictionary. They are search aliases, not official Vietnamese localization, and have confidence E.
The community item catalog is broader than the in-game Item Files scope and is used only as a taxonomy and coverage cross-check, not as the identity boundary for this snapshot.

region is present only when ItemGatherTextTable explicitly assigns a client domainId. The current 45 records resolve through DomainDataTable to Valley IV or Wuling; no region is inferred from an item name or general availability.
client_icon_id is the client-backed presentation key. Bundled thumbnails are fetched non-destructively from the indexed extracted asset path and are not naming evidence.

unresolved.reason: The dictionary returned no Hán-Việt reading for one or more Han characters.
